protocol.reporting_rule: retain all 12 tasks x 6 methods and every predeclared method-specific evaluation seed; kernel methods use 0,1,2 and deterministic HistGBR uses 0
protocol.primary_endpoint: For each task and method, calculate RMSE separately for each locked evaluation seed, average the seed RMSEs, divide by the target-farm capacity, and then average the six task values with equal site weight.
protocol.rank_endpoint: Average of within-task ranks of seed-mean RMSE; lower is better and exact ties receive their average rank.

full_comparisons.observation_loss: squared error in MW^2 averaged over each method's predeclared algorithmic evaluation seeds within each forecast timestamp
full_comparisons.effect: Full minus comparator; negative values favor Full
full_comparisons.block: non-overlapping Monday--Sunday seven-calendar-day blocks, using a fixed 1970-01-05 Monday origin
full_comparisons.bootstrap: 10,000 equal-probability block resamples within a task; each draw is a ratio of sampled block loss sums to sampled block counts; percentile 95% interval
full_comparisons.sign_flip: 99,999 Monte Carlo two-sided paired block sign flips with the plus-one correction
full_comparisons.multiplicity: Holm adjustment in two separate 30-test families: 6 tasks x 5 comparators for within and for cross

first_tier.name: conservative all-pairs non-rejection set
first_tier.procedure: Within each scope, compare all 15 method pairs by a two-sided seven-day block-swap randomization test of the site-equal macro capacity-normalized seed-mean RMSE difference. Apply Holm to all 15 comparisons. The set contains the empirical endpoint winner and every method not shown worse than that winner at adjusted alpha 0.05.
first_tier.interpretation: Membership means that inferiority to the empirical winner was not established under this block assumption; it is not evidence of equivalence and is not a formal Hansen model-confidence set.

protocol.heldout_guard: Do not read results.json, result.json, calibration predictions, or test predictions before selection_lock.json passes validation, including 18 effective unique queries in each stage and 54 across stages for every one of the 72 task-method selections.
